title: Heartless Mod
description: A challenge mod, that adds hearts to the game
body:
New Update!

Heartless, is a mod focused on making Minecrafts Health system, more interesting,

The curse,
you start with a cursed heart,
if you click on it your 
health is reduceed to 1, >:3
![Cursed Heart](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f5d4c3c6fd5ba4ba600dbcda82a3378c0a5bb8f1_0.webp)

Heart,
Return back to normal!
![Heart](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/650366fe5886ee8b1cfb2b1461108033e61986be_0.webp)

Golden heart,
Get one extra row of hearts!
![Golden Heart](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c2acc1787605595a38b21b7920bb3da9702710b1_0.webp)

Craft a soul,
With 9 bones, spider eyes, or rotten flesh,
you get a soul
![Soul Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/45623ad160c1e47a8e2bb153d9e34cf90a5d232b_0.webp)

![Soul Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2797d06327eb510a413e13e5fdbcaf413921c5ca_0.webp)

![Soul Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6fdf39430c6904696d3c89eaa94a4096bec1c1d6_0.webp)


Craft a heart,
With 1 soul and 4 diamonds
you get, a heart,
![Heart Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/567bd38e210ba48caacfb1dc32c1b42d7ca3796a_0.webp)

Craft a golden heart,
with 1 heart, 4 molten gold, and 4 souls,
you get a golden heart,
![Golden Heart Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/69cad81031e8007545648270d6af41b458fc7ed1_0.webp)


And that's all for now, bye
